review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Town Team is a fashion brand that has been redefining menswear since 1998, with a strong focus on creativity and self-expression. The company encourages individuals to step beyond comfort zones, embrace their unique identity, and explore bold styles. With evolving collections for men and kids, Town Team offers contemporary trends that push the limits of fashion and aim to stay ahead of the curve. The brand’s mission is to inspire modern customers to live with passion, stay curious, and express themselves confidently through their personal style. Role Description The Infrastructure Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Markaz Tanta. This role is responsible for managing and maintaining the company’s IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, and related hardware and software. Daily tasks include monitoring system performance, diagnosing and resolving technical issues, implementing updates and patches, and ensuring reliable connectivity for all users. The Infrastructure Specialist collaborates with IT Operations and other departments to support business needs, enhance system reliability, and contribute to IT-related projects and improvements. The role also involves applying best practices for network security and documenting infrastructure changes and incident resolutions. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Infrastructure and IT Operations skills to manage servers, systems, and related hardware and software. Candidates should possess solid Networking and Network Security skills to ensure stable, secure, and efficient data communication. Candidates should possess effective Troubleshooting skills to diagnose, analyze, and resolve technical issues in a timely manner. Relevant experience in corporate IT environments, preferably within retail or fashion sectors, is beneficial. Knowledge of operating systems (e.g., Windows, Linux), virtualization, and cloud-based services is an advantage. Strong documentation, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to support non-technical team members. Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to work on-site in Markaz Tanta and respond to infrastructure incidents as needed.

review_candidates.title: Quality control instruments sales specilist
review_candidates.description: Company Description PAN ARAB Commercial and Technical Consultancy Company (PACT Egypt) has been supplying quality test equipment to industrial and laboratory customers since 1980. The company offers a wide range of testing machines designed for quality control, production, and research, with a focus on cost-effective solutions for evaluating physical and mechanical properties of materials, components, and finished products. PACT Egypt is committed to driving change, growth, and development for its customers through high-quality products and reliable service. For more than 25 years, it has been a leading supplier and distributor of testing equipment for sectors such as paper, rubber, leather, plastic, textile, paint, and universal testing in Egypt. PACT represents reputable international manufacturers including Tinius Olsen/Hounsfield, Sheen Instruments, RK Instruments, Reprotest IGT, RDM Test Equipment, TMI Group, and Q-Panel, ensuring dependable products and service support. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site role based in Giza for a Quality Control Instruments Sales Specialist. The role involves identifying and pursuing sales opportunities for quality testing equipment, managing customer accounts, and building long-term relationships with industrial and laboratory clients. The specialist will conduct product presentations and demonstrations, prepare quotes and technical proposals, and support customers in selecting suitable instruments based on their testing requirements. Daily tasks include coordinating with internal technical and service teams, following up on orders and deliveries, and maintaining accurate sales records and reports. The role also includes staying updated on industry developments, competitor offerings, and new products to effectively position PACT Egypt’s solutions in the market. Qualifications Strong sales, negotiation, and customer relationship skills, with the ability to manage the full sales cycle for technical products. Technical understanding of quality control and testing instruments, ideally in fields such as materials testing, laboratory equipment, or industrial machinery. Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders. Solid organizational and time management skills, including experience with reporting, CRM tools, and basic MS Office applications. Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related technical or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Previous experience in B2B sales, preferably in testing equipment, laboratory instruments, or industrial solutions, is highly beneficial. Ability to work on-site in Giza, conduct client visits, and travel within Egypt as needed. Professional proficiency in English and Arabic, both written and spoken.

review_candidates.title: Customer Support
review_candidates.description: Company Description MediLink360.ai is the UAE’s first AI-native, cloud-powered, and blockchain-secured platform focused on transforming digital healthcare engagement. The company delivers an end-to-end health ecosystem that seamlessly connects patients, healthcare providers, and insurers in a secure environment. Its solutions include an AI-powered symptom checker using text, voice, and vision, real-time appointment booking, and multilingual access in Arabic, English, Hindi, and other languages. MediLink360.ai also offers real-time insurance verification to simplify care access and streamline administrative processes. Guided by UAE Vision 2031, the company’s mission is to unlock inclusive, efficient, and future-ready healthcare for diverse communities. Role Description The Customer Support role at MediLink360.ai is a full-time, on-site position based in Cairo, Egypt. This role involves responding to customer inquiries through multiple channels, resolving issues related to platform access, symptom checking, appointment booking, and insurance verification, and documenting each interaction in the support system. The Customer Support team member will provide clear explanations of platform features, guide users step-by-step through troubleshooting processes, and work closely with technical and product teams to escalate and follow up on complex cases. The role also includes monitoring recurring issues, sharing customer feedback to improve services, and maintaining high standards of customer satisfaction and data privacy in line with healthcare and company guidelines. Qualifications Strong Customer Support and Customer Satisfaction skills, with experience handling inquiries and resolving issues in a structured, professional manner. Excellent Interpersonal Skills, including active listening, empathy, and the ability to communicate clearly with diverse users and stakeholders. Technical Support capabilities, with the ability to understand digital platforms, follow troubleshooting steps, and collaborate effectively with technical teams. Analytical Skills to interpret user problems, identify patterns, and propose improvements to support processes and customer experience. Proficiency in English; knowledge of Arabic and other languages is an advantage. Previous experience in healthcare, health tech, or SaaS customer support is beneficial. Comfort working in an on-site, fast-paced environment and coordinating with cross-functional teams. Diploma or bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (such as Communications, Business, IT, or Healthcare) or equivalent practical experience.
